formulas.name: A complex number times its conjugate
formulas.text: (a + ib)(a − ib) = a² + b²
match: Multiply above and below by the conjugate

formulas.name: Modulus and amplitude
formulas.text: r = √(x² + y²) and tan θ = y/x

formulas.name: Modulus amplitude form
formulas.text: z = r(cos θ + i sin θ)
match: z = r(cos θ + i sin θ)

formulas.name: Conjugate of a complex number
formulas.text: The conjugate of a + ib is a − ib
match: The conjugate of a + ib is a − ib

formulas.name: The square of i
formulas.text: i² = −1

formulas.name: De Moivre's theorem
formulas.text: (cos θ + i sin θ)ⁿ = cos nθ + i sin nθ
match: By De Moivre's theorem the angle is multiplied
(cos θ + i sin θ)ⁿ = cos nθ + i sin nθ

formulas.name: Adding a pair of conjugate expansions
formulas.text: Adding the two expansions cancels the i sin terms
match: expansion is the same with the sin term negative

formulas.name: Sum and product of the roots
formulas.text: α + β = −b/a and αβ = c/a

formulas.name: Condition for real roots
formulas.text: Δ = b² − 4ac ≥ 0

formulas.name: Sign of a quadratic expression
formulas.text: A quadratic is ≤ 0 only between its roots
match: A product is ≤ 0 BETWEEN its roots

formulas.name: Root relations of a cubic
formulas.text: S₁ = −a₁/a₀, S₂ = a₂/a₀, S₃ = −a₃/a₀

formulas.name: Reciprocal equation substitution
formulas.text: Put x + 1/x = t, so x² + 1/x² = t² − 2

formulas.name: Arrangements when some things are alike
match: When n things have p, q, r alike

formulas.name: When two combinations are equal
formulas.text: ⁿCᵣ = ⁿCₛ gives r = s or r + s = n
match: ⁿCᵣ = ⁿCₛ ⇒ r = s or r + s = n

formulas.name: Number of combinations
formulas.text: ⁿCᵣ = n!/(r!(n − r)!)

formulas.name: Number of arrangements
formulas.text: ⁿPᵣ = n!/(n − r)!

formulas.name: Circular arrangements
formulas.text: n things in a circle: (n − 1)! ways

formulas.name: General term of a binomial expansion
formulas.text: In (x + y)ⁿ, Tᵣ₊₁ = ⁿCᵣ xⁿ⁻ʳ yʳ

formulas.name: Expansion for a negative or fractional index
formulas.text: Compare with the standard series for (1 + x)^p
match: A negative power inverts the fraction

formulas.name: Middle term of a binomial expansion
formulas.text: n even: one middle term. n odd: two

formulas.name: Finding a partial fraction constant
formulas.text: Put a root of one factor: every other term becomes 0
match: Substituting a root of one factor

formulas.name: An improper fraction must be divided first
formulas.text: Divide out a polynomial when the top degree is not less than the bottom
match: improper and a polynomial must come out first
The numerator's degree is not less than

formulas.name: A repeated factor
formulas.text: A repeated factor gets one term for each power
match: A repeated factor gets one term

formulas.name: Mean of a set of values
formulas.text: x̄ = (sum of the values)/n

formulas.name: Mean deviation
formulas.text: The average size of the gaps from a centre, signs ignored
match: Mean deviation measures how far the values

formulas.name: Standard deviation
formulas.text: σ = √(variance)

formulas.name: Addition theorem of probability
formulas.text: P(A ∪ B) = P(A) + P(B) − P(A ∩ B)
match: P(A ∪ B) = P(A) + P(B) − P(A ∩ B)

formulas.name: Bayes' theorem
formulas.text: It turns a known P(A | B) into the wanted P(B | A)

formulas.name: Conditional probability
formulas.text: P(A | B) = P(A ∩ B)/P(B), P(B) ≠ 0

formulas.name: Independent events
formulas.text: P(A ∩ B) = P(A)·P(B)

formulas.name: Mutually exclusive events
formulas.text: P(A ∪ B) = P(A) + P(B) when A and B cannot both happen

formulas.name: Probabilities of a distribution add to one
formulas.text: ΣP(X = xᵢ) = 1

formulas.name: Mean of a random variable
formulas.text: μ = Σxᵢ·P(X = xᵢ)

formulas.name: Variance of a random variable
formulas.text: σ² = Σxᵢ²·P(X = xᵢ) − μ²

formulas.name: Binomial distribution
formulas.text: P(X = r) = ⁿCᵣ qⁿ⁻ʳ pʳ, with mean np and variance npq
